pullRequests.title: docs: short README and docs sorted into folders
pullRequests.author: nickyyOO
pullRequests.head: docs/readme-cleanup
pullRequests.body:
Before
A long README with setup steps and hand-updated progress tables, and docs in one flat folder with mixed-case names.
After
A short README like Lombyte's: the OpenRAC logo with " decompilation project" under it, a code badge and a note for each version, quick setup, credits and license. Progress comes only from the ByteMatch badges, so the README needs no commit when progress moves. The details moved to docs/, now sorted into docs/build, docs/contributing, docs/agents and docs/history…

commits.headline: docs: short README and docs sorted into folders (#143)

commits.body:
* docs: short README and docs sorted into folders

Rewrite the README in the style of Lombyte's: OpenRAC logo, a short intro,
the progress tables (still written by tools/progress.py), supported
versions with a code badge each, quick setup, credits and license. The
badges by part and by level move to docs/build/progress.md, the full setup
to docs/build/building.md.

Sort every doc into docs/build, docs/contributing, docs/agents and
docs/history (notes/ included), with lowercase names, and fix…
